Caribou Cumulative Effects report

Date: 2026-10-27

Herd: Little Rancheria - Annual range (YG)

This report summaries disturbance metrics for the Little Rancheria - Annual range (YG) herd. The annual range spans 13715 km², of which 87.6% is classified as undisturbed and 12.4% as disturbed. In this analysis, disturbed areas include only features selected for this assessment: buffered anthropogenic disturbances only. Undisturbed areas are defined as all remaining portions of the herd range not intersected by these selected disturbances, regardless of the presence of other disturbance types that may exist within the herd range but were not included in the analysis.

Anthropogenic disturbances include 2798.0 km of linear features and 81.2 km² of areal disturbances.

To generate the disturbed areas layer, a generic buffer of 500 m for linear features and 500 m for areal disturbances was used.

The following disturbance types were present within the herd range but excluded from the disturbed areas: mining claims and fires.

Protected areas account for 2.4 of the range.
